observed_point.historical_anchor_reason: The original __pooled__ is the all-common 20,799-row cohort; this 10,286-row testA+testB cohort is new and is not anchored to the historical all-common point.

method_verification.binning: 15 equal-mass bins per statistic evaluation, with cuts snapped to confidence tie boundaries; bins are not fixed from the observed sample
method_verification.interpretation: The percentile bootstrap interval need not contain the observed statistic. Here the replicate distribution is right-shifted relative to the observed mean, which is consistent with a finite-sample bootstrap shift for a nonlinear absolute calibration-error estimator. This pattern alone does not establish the magnitude of estimator bias or invalidate the frozen percentile procedure.
